access_route.text: the lock-warden rows them across and lets them in through the winch loft, oar over shoulder

cipher_form.text: tide arithmetic: add the moon day to the posted hour and carry past twelve to read each hoist

access_route.text: the dry sluice culvert, walkable at low water since the new channel took the flow
winding the tide engine's counterweight to its top mark lifts the winch loft hatch ajar

curiosity.text: toll ledgers in waterproof bindings, every cargo and flood of eighty years ruled in red

hint_carrier.text: the weir gates sluice in a repeating run, long, long, short, the same run the flags spell

curiosity.text: generations of keepers' initials scratched shoulder-high along the catwalk door frame

hint_carrier.text: hand-polish on the hoist levers, deepest where the right pulls land, faint where they never do
depth figures stamped up the engine racks, climbing by the same carry the hoists use

obstacle.text: the unlit tail-race tunnel, dry underfoot and black, walked by counting paces between light wells

curiosity.text: a grey heron that keeps evening watch from the gate beam and minds visitors not at all

hint_carrier.text: a gate cross-section pinned in the winch loft, its margins working tide sums beside each hoist

remedy.text: the posted rule at the racks: ease back a quarter turn before asking a full one

contents.text: a tiny working river model, its fingernail gates opening on a true tide

loft_signature.text: a rooftop reed garden still green, watered by a cistern drip the engineer rigged to last

n_end_secret.mechanism: some unfinished work in the room invites their hands, and finishing it becomes their standing assignment

safeguard.text: fine river silt dusted on the strongroom floor keeps every footprint for the warden's morning read

n_end_caught.mechanism: what they try to carry out is exactly what the trial was built to catch on the way down

n_end_library.mechanism: the archive teaches them what the trial was really testing, arming a wiser second attempt

n_end_giveup.mechanism: one friend names the real risk aloud and the others agree without argument, calling it a passed test of judgment

n_end_timeout.mechanism: the overworked mechanism raises a polite fuss that brings the keeper up to end the attempt for the night

n_end_stuck.mechanism: the forced dial binds fast, and nothing they carry tonight will answer for it

n_end_hero.mechanism: the passing earns the keeper's open trust and a standing invitation back to the tower

n_end_keepsake.mechanism: a pact sworn over the keepsake binds the friends as the trial's private graduates

label_style: terse imperatives, three words where possible
